name: Paragraph Enter
tip: The Toggle paragraph Enter and Insert line break commands have no default hotkey. Assign them in Settings, then Hotkeys. You can also select the paragraph mark in the status bar to switch the mode.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Paragraph Enter is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for writing with it.
